scope_note: The controlled-substance operations group with the quality and reporting section, repaired after the V7 round because all four turn on the same Massachusetts theft-and-loss law. The repair supplies the three Massachusetts routes the security section had missed entirely (247 CMR 20.03(7) to the Board within seven days with a copy of DEA Form 106; M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 15 simultaneous copies to the local and state police; 105 CMR 700.008 for Department registrants), grounds a pharmacy's federal duty in 21 CFR 1301.76(b) rather than the non-practitioner paragraph, corrects the account of 21 CFR 1305.17(e) so the ordering section no longer contradicts a released question, and supplies 247 CMR 15.04(2), which the quality section had said did not exist. Eighteen additive rules carry the law. MA-Q-0384 was removed from SG-CS-SECURITY-AND-DISPOSAL because its key applies the 105 CMR 700.005(B)(2) employment bar to a Board-licensed pharmacy; that is a question-lane referral. Scope gate: three signals used, the rest declined as other sections' declared subjects or as provisions carrying no such standard.
